system.description: This spell improves the morale of friendly creatures by +1 and gives the recipients a +1 bonus on all attack and damage rolls. It will only affect creatures in a 20' X 20' area, and only those who are not yet in melee. When reversed, this spell, blight, places a - 1 penalty on enemies' morale, attack rolls, and damage rolls. Each victim may make a saving throw vs. spells to avoid the penalties.
